title: Stance and how firmly values hold
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0050 no longer matches the current design.
decision: Stance is the agents context's stance factor; how firmly a value holds against override is its enforcement level; an act is refused only where enforcement-level's test is met (0142).
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
